questions.stem: Which of the following is a type of storm that is accompanied by lightning and thunder?
questions.solution: A thunderstorm is a type of storm that is accompanied by lightning and thunder, which is a defining characteristic of this weather phenomenon. Cyclones, tornadoes, and hurricanes can be intense storms, but they are not specifically defined by the presence of lightning and thunder. Thunderstorms involve the rapid movement of air and the buildup of electrical charges, leading to lightning and the sound of thunder.

questions.stem: Which of the following is a result of the movement of warm and moist air?
choices: Cooler air flows to replace it
It creates a high pressure area
It causes the ground to become negatively charged
It leads to the formation of lightning
questions.solution: When warm and moist air rises, it creates a low-pressure area, which causes cooler air to flow in and replace it. This is a direct consequence of the movement of warm air. The other options are incorrect because high pressure is not created by rising warm air, and there is no direct link between warm air movement and the ground becoming charged or lightning formation.

questions.stem: What is the main reason for making holes in banners and hoardings?
choices: To make them easier to carry

questions.stem: What happens to the water droplets in the clouds when the air expands and cools?
choices: They rise higher in the clouds
They separate into positive and negative charges
questions.solution: When air expands and cools, the water droplets in the clouds can freeze into ice particles due to the low temperatures at higher altitudes. This process is a direct result of the temperature drop, making the formation of ice particles the correct answer. The other options describe different phenomena, such as precipitation or charge separation, which are not directly caused by the cooling and expansion of air alone.

questions.stem: If a person stands on one foot instead of two, what happens to the pressure exerted on the ground?
questions.solution: Pressure is defined as force per unit area. If the area decreases (standing on one foot instead of two), the pressure increases. Since the force remains the same, the pressure doubles. The other options do not correctly represent the relationship between force and area.

questions.stem: A person standing on a flat surface experiences a pressure of 1000 N/m². If the person stands on a smaller area of 0.5 m², what will be the new pressure?
questions.solution: Pressure is force divided by area. If the area is halved, the pressure doubles. The correct calculation is 1000 / 0.5 = 2000 N/m². The other options do not match the correct calculation.

questions.stem: If the pressure in a region is 1000 Pa, and the area of a roof is 20 m², what is the force acting on the roof due to air pressure?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 20000 N. The formula for pressure is pressure = force / area, so force = pressure × area. Therefore, force = 1000 Pa × 20 m² = 20000 N. The other options are incorrect because they do not use the correct formula or miscalculate the multiplication.

hi.stem: यदि किसी क्षेत्र में दाब 1000 पैस्कल है, और छत का क्षेत्रफल 20 वर्ग मीटर है, तो हवा के दाब के कारण छत पर लगने वाला बल क्या है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर 20000 न्यूटन है। दाब का सूत्र दाब = बल / क्षेत्रफल है, इसलिए बल = दाब × क्षेत्रफल। इसलिए, बल = 1000 पैस्कल × 20 वर्ग मीटर = 20000 न्यूटन। अन्य विकल्प गलत हैं क्योंकि वे सही सूत्र का उपयोग नहीं करते हैं या गुणन की गणना में गलती करते हैं।

questions.stem: If a water tank is placed at a height of 20 meters, and the pressure at the base is 200,000 Pa, what is the density of the liquid in the tank? (Take g = 10 m/s²)
questions.solution: The correct answer is '1000 kg/m³.' This is calculated using the formula: Pressure = density × g × height. Rearranging the formula, we get density = pressure / (g × height). Substituting the values, we get 200000 / (10 × 20) = 1000 kg/m³. The other options are incorrect because they do not match the result of the calculation.

questions.stem: A cylinder filled with water is placed on a table, and a small hole is made at the bottom of the cylinder. What will happen to the water coming out of the hole?
choices: It will not flow out at all
It will flow out in all directions
questions.solution: The water will flow out horizontally because the pressure from the column of water above the hole pushes the water outward in the direction perpendicular to the surface of the hole. Vertical flow would require a force pulling the water down, which is not the case here. The water does not flow out in all directions because the hole is a single point, and it does flow out, so the option that it will not flow at all is incorrect.
